pkgmetadata.longdescription: NGINX Unit is a dynamic multi-language web application server. It runs Python, PHP, Perl, Go, JavaScript, Ruby and Java application code in a single runtime and natively serves static assets. Configuration is done via a REST API and applied live without restarts. This build provides the core unitd daemon plus PHP application modules for the selected dev-lang/php slots (linked against the embed SAPI of each slot).
